output.reason: The release note [ev-7ca361d9f17c] is vague, but the linked PR fills the gap. [ev-13ff01be5828] says the init container is now told where the crds and webhookconfigurations directories are, and the Helm chart gets a new opt-in "ko mode" flag that rewrites the image to the ko://<package path> form without tags. [ev-1791bf083f9e] says it adds an earthly +ko-init entrypoint for development and that defaults are unchanged, so nothing changes for anyone not using ko. The changed files [ev-98534b0ca5d3] confirm the edits are to the chart values/deployment templates and to init.go. This is enough to record an additive, opt-in developer-workflow change that does nothing to environments left at defaults, though the exact values key is not named in the excerpt.
